blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is the central training paradigm for advancing large foundation models towards self-improvement. This report introduces the MiMo-V2.6 series, an omni-modal family that pushes the frontier of model intelligence by scaling RL compute. Prior to RL, we conduct mid-training on a broad multimodal corpus to provide ample exploration space, and build a solid infrastructure on the pretrained hybrid-SWA architecture to support subsequent scale-up. We scale RL compute along three dimensions: (1) larger batches and higher throughput, with an asynchronous training that consumes 1,568 samples and 2.7-3.7B tokens per step at context lengths of up to 1M; (2) more diverse and complex environments, spanning code, general, visual, and cyber domains under a mixture of agent harnesses; and (3) more grader compute, via groupwise agentic grading that yields more accurate reward signals for long-horizon tasks and steers the model towards shorter, more token-efficient solutions. To keep training stable at scale, we freeze the MoE router and establish a multi-layer defense against reward hacking. We further build infrastructure for mixed-task agentic RL, including a unified trajectory representation, high-concurrency multi-framework rollout, decoupled control and data planes, and training-inference consistency. We open-source the training dynamics, RL environments, and RL framework to facilitate reproduction and further research on scaled RL and model self-improvement.
blocks.zh: 强化学习(RL)是推动大型基础模式走向自我完善的核心培训模式. 这份报告介绍了MiMo-V2.6系列,这是一个通过缩放RL计算来推动模型智能前沿的全能模式家族. 在重新开放之前,我们进行关于一项广泛的多式联运文书的中期培训,以提供充分的探索空间,并在经过预先培训的混合-西南亚结构上建立一个坚实的基础设施,以支持随后的扩展。 我们按三个维度进行RL计算:(1) 批量较大,吞吐量更高,同步训练每步消耗1 568个样本和2.7-3.7B个信使,其上下文长度可达1M;(2) 在代理吊带的混合下,更多样化和复杂的环境,跨越代码,一般,视觉和网络领域;(3) 通过分组代理分级,通过更精确的奖励信号来计算长视距任务,并将模型导向更短,更象征性的解决方案. 为了保持训练在规模上的稳定,我们冻结了MOE路由器,并建立了多层防御,防止奖励黑客入侵. 我们进一步建设混合任务代理RL的基础设施,包括统一的轨迹代表、高通币多框架推出、脱钩控制和数据飞机以及培训参考一致性。 我们开放培训动态、RL环境和RL框架,以便利复制和进一步研究规模化RL和模型自我改进。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recursive self-improvement (RSI) envisions models that expand their capabilities through sustained exploration and feedback.
Realizing this vision requires agents, which couple models with interactive environments and thereby supply the multi-step trajectories and feedback signals that self-improvement depends on.
Towards this goal, scaling reinforcement learning (RL) on complex agentic tasks thus opens a concrete path.
However, realizing this potential faces two major challenges. First, RL for foundation models requires suitable model architectures and a sufficiently rich exploration space for agents. Second, scaling RL requires sophisticated solutions for infrastructure, environments and grader.
In this report, we introduce the MiMo-V2.6 series, including MiMo-V2.6-Pro, a 1.02T-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 42B active parameters, and MiMo-V2.6-Flash, a 310B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 15B active parameters, to bridge these gaps, taking a practical step in large-scale RL.
blocks.zh:
不断自我改进(RSI)设想的模式通过持续的探索和反馈来扩大其能力。
实现这一愿景需要代理商,这些代理商将模型与互动环境结合起来,从而提供自我改进所依赖的多步轨迹和反馈信号。
为了实现这一目标,在复杂的代理任务上扩大强化学习,从而开辟了一条具体的道路。
然而,实现这一潜力面临两大挑战。 首先,基础模型的RL需要合适的模型架构和足够丰富的物剂探索空间. 第二,扩大RL需要针对基础设施、环境和分级器的复杂解决方案。
在本报告中,我们引入了MiMo-V2.6系列,包括MiMo-V2.6-Pro,一个具有42B活性参数的1.02T参数的Mixture-of-Experts模型;以及MiMo-V2.6-Flash,一个具有15B活性参数的310B参数的Mixture-of-Experts模型来弥补这些差距,在大规模RL上迈出了实际一步.

blocks.en:
The architecture, pre-training, and mid-training of MiMo-V2.6 jointly establish a powerful and efficient foundation model.
Motivated by the need to preserve global context at low computational cost, MiMo-V2.6 builds a hybrid sparse MoE Transformer backbone that interleaves Local Sliding Window Attention (SWA) with Global Attention (GA), augmented by a lightweight visual encoder, audio encoders.
In addition, large-scale pre-training equips the model with extensive knowledge and versatile multimodal understanding across text, audio, and video.
We further introduce an agent-centric mid-training phase that expands the exploration space for agentic tasks, enabling the model to discover more effective task-solving trajectories during post-training.
blocks.zh:
MiMo-V2.6的架构,预训和中训共同建立了强大而高效的基础模式.
由于需要以低计算成本保护全球背景,MiMo-V2.6搭建了混合型稀疏的MoE变形器主干线,将本地滑行窗口关注(SWA)与全球关注(GA)相接出,并辅以轻量级视觉编码器,音频编码器.
此外,大规模预训使该模式具备广泛的知识和跨文本、音频和视频的多功能多式联运。
我们进一步引入以物剂为中心的中期培训阶段,为物剂任务扩大探索空间,使模型能够在后培训中发现更有效的任务解决轨迹.

blocks.en:
Next, we scale the RL compute through a systematic, co-designed framework spanning three key components.
First, we scale batch size and training throughput through fully asynchronous training, processing thousands of long-horizon rollouts and billions of tokens per step at context lengths of up to 1M.
Second, we scale the diversity and complexity of RL environments across coding, general, visual, and cybersecurity tasks, using diverse agent harnesses and strengthening safeguards against reward hacking.
Varying both the harness and the task improves the model generalization.
Third, we introduce groupwise agentic grading to provide more informative reward signals beyond binary test cases. Instead of assigning the same reward to all solutions that pass the test cases, we compare solutions within each group to distinguish problem-solving quality and behaviors. Through our proposed Groupwise Reward Synthesis (GRS) and Groupwise Advantage Redistribution (GAR), these fine-grained distinctions are converted into more informative learning signals, guiding the model toward more accurate and efficient solutions.
blocks.zh:
其次,我们通过一个涵盖三个关键组成部分的系统化、共同设计的框架来扩大RL计算。
首先,我们通过完全同步的训练来扩大批量规模和培训的吞吐量,处理上千个长相线的推出和每步数十亿个令牌,其上下文长度可达1M.
第二,我们利用多种代理手段,加强防范奖励黑客的保障措施,在编码、一般、视觉和网络安全任务中扩大RL环境的多样性和复杂性。
无论是牵引装置还是任务都不同,可以改进模型的通化.
第三,我们引入分组代理分级,提供比二进制测试案例更丰富的奖励信号. 我们不是对所有通过测试的解决方案给予同样的奖励,而是比较每个组内的解决方案,以区别解决问题的质量和行为. 通过我们提议的Groupwise Reward Syndrome(GRS)和Groupwise Advantage Redistration(GAR),这些精细的区别被转换成更加翔实的学习信号,引导模型走向更加准确高效的解决方案.

blocks.en:
Realizing these at scale presents both research and engineering challenges for infrastructure.
To support flexible agentic interaction scenarios, we design a unified trajectory representation and a penalty mechanism that together refine the learning signal.
To handle large training batches, we sustain high-concurrency interaction across diverse agent frameworks through a pool of harness, and decouple the control plane from the data plane to buffer and transfer massive trajectories carrying routing and multi-modal payloads.
A sample mixing mechanism, working together with dynamic sampling and partial rollout, stabilizes per-task sample composition in train batches.
We align the training and inference engines on MoE routing and top- p sampling candidate sets, and optimize both engines for RL workloads.
blocks.zh:
大规模地实现这些目标,对基础设施和工程提出了研究和挑战。
为了支持灵活的能动交互情景,我们设计了一个统一的轨迹表述和惩罚机制,共同完善学习信号.
为了处理大批次的训练,我们通过各种剂剂框架保持高货币相互作用,把控制平面从数据平面上脱钩,以缓冲和转移载有路由和多模式有效载荷的大型轨迹。
与动态采样和部分推开配合的样品混合机制,稳定了列车批次中每个任务样本的构成.
我们调整了教育部路线和顶级抽样候选设备的培训和推论引擎,优化了两个引擎的RL工作量。

blocks.en:
Scaling RL compute substantially unlocks model potential on both verifiable tasks such as coding and less verifiable tasks such as web development.
As shown in Figure 1 , both MiMo-V2.6-Pro and MiMo-V2.6-Flash steadily improve their performance across the reported benchmarks as training steps increase.
Moreover, these gains are not confined to a single domain, but hold consistently across diverse tasks spanning coding on DeepSWE ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , general workflows on AutomationBench ( Shepard and Salimans, 2026 ) , visual tasks on MiMo Visual Coding, and cybersecurity on MiMo Cyber Bench.
These gains indicate that MiMo-V2.6 is capable of stronger complex problem solving and more reliable performance in daily co-work scenarios, reflecting more general agentic intelligence.
blocks.zh:
缩放 RL 计算在编码等可核查任务和网络开发等可核查程度较低的任务上都大大解锁了模型潜力.
如图1所显示,随着培训步骤的增加,MiMo-V2.6-Pro和MiMo-V2.6-Flash在所报告的基准方面的业绩稳步改善。
此外,这些收益并不局限于一个单一领域,而是在DeepSWE(Huang等,2026年),自动化奔驰(Shepard和Salimans,2026年)的一般工作流程,米莫视觉编码的视觉任务,米莫网络座椅的网络安全等多个不同任务之间持续地保持.
这些成绩表明,米莫-V2.6能够在日常的同工场景中更能解决更复杂的问题并更可靠地发挥性能,能反映更一般的代理智能.

blocks.en: To promote research in agentic RL, we open-source a comprehensive suite covering the key components of the RL development stack, including the lightweight model MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B, curated task environments with verifiers across multiple domains, an end-to-end RL training framework, and a composable mini-harness for flexible agentic interactions. Together, these components provide a unified and accessible platform for studying agentic RL under diverse tasks, environments, and agent configurations, while reducing the engineering barriers to reproducing and extending large-scale RL experiments. Experiments with MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B demonstrate consistent RL gains across diverse tasks and agent harnesses, validating the effectiveness and generality of the proposed suite. We hope this open-source suite can serve as a fair, strong, and reproducible baseline for the community, enabling systematic investigation of agentic RL and advancing research toward recursive self-improvement.
blocks.zh: 为了促进代理RL的研究,我们开源了一个涵盖RL开发堆栈关键组件的综合性套件,包括轻量级模型MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Quen-9B,具有跨多领域验证器的任务环境,端到端的RL训练框架,以及灵活代理相互作用的可相容小型harness. 这些组件合在一起,为研究不同任务,环境和代理配置下的代理RL提供了一个统一而方便的平台,同时减少了复制和扩展大规模RL实验的工程障碍. 与MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Quen-9B的实验表明,在各种任务和代理人利用方面,RL的得分一致,证明了拟议套房的有效性和通俗性。 我们希望这个开放源码套件能够成为社区公平、有力和可复制的基线,从而能够系统地调查代理RL,并推进对递归自我改进的研究。

blocks.en: 2 Architecture
blocks.zh: 2 建筑

blocks.en: 2.1 Overall Architecture
blocks.zh: 2.1 总体结构

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 2 , MiMo-V2.6 follows a standard Transformer ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) backbone, augmented with visual and audio encoders connected through lightweight projectors.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,MiMo-V2.6采用标准变形器(Vaswani等,2017年)主干,并用通过轻量级投影仪连接的视觉和音频编码器来增强.

blocks.en:
The text backbone of MiMo-V2.6 is mainly composed of repeated hybrid blocks that interleave Local Sliding Window Attention (SWA) and Global Attention (GA).
It stacks M M hybrid blocks, each structured with N N consecutive SWA blocks followed by a GA block.
The only exception is the very first Transformer block, which uses global attention with a dense Feed-Forward Network (FFN) to stabilize early representation learning. The sliding window size W W used in MiMo-V2.6 is 128 128 . Both the SWA block and the GA block utilize a sparse MoE FFN without shared experts.
MiMo-V2.6 also integrates an SWA and dense FFN based MTP ( Gloeckle et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2025 ) to improve model performance during pre-training.
A more comprehensive description of the text backbone architecture can be found in Core Team et al. (2026) .
The model configurations are shown in Table 1 .
blocks.zh:
MiMo-V2.6的文本主干线主要由反复的混合块所组成,这些块互通了本地滑行窗口关注(SWA)和Global关注(GA).
它堆放出M M 混合块,每个块结构上都有N N 相接的 SWA 块,后有GA 块.
唯一的例外是第一个变形板块,它利用密集的Feed-Forward Network(FFN)的全球关注来稳定早期的代表学习. MiMo-V2.6中使用的滑动窗口大小为128 128. SWA区块和GA区块都使用一个没有共享专家的稀少的MOE FFN.
MiMo-V2.6还整合了以SWA和密集FFN为基础的MTP(Gloeckle等,2024;Liu等,2024;Xia等,2025),以提高在预训期间的模型性能.

blocks.en: 2.2 MiMo-ViT
blocks.zh: 2.2 米莫维塔

blocks.en:
MiMo-ViT adopts a hybrid attention architecture. It replaces fixed, non-overlapping window attention in MiMo-VL-7B ( Yue et al., 2025 ) with sink-augmented SWA, enabling information exchange across window boundaries over successive layers and mitigating visual fragmentation. Local SWA layers alternate between row-major and column-major token serialization to support information propagation along both spatial axes. Finally, GA layers are inserted periodically to aggregate global context directly. This design substantially reduces the computational cost of high-resolution visual processing while achieving performance comparable to GA ViTs. Please refer to He et al. (2026) for more analysis.
To pre-train MiMo-ViT from scratch, we pair it with a small pre-trained LLM and optimize the resulting VLM solely on multimodal understanding data using a cross-entropy objective. This simple recipe avoids auxiliary objectives such as contrastive learning, making pre-training efficient and scalable. Crucially, the LLM remains trainable to provide stable, semantically meaningful gradients to the ViT. After pre-training on more than 4T image tokens, MiMo-ViT learns strong visual representations and serves as a robust foundation for MiMo-V2.6.
blocks.zh:
MiMo-ViT采用了混合关注架构. 它将MiMo-VL-7B(Yue等,2025年)中固定的、非重叠的窗口注意力取而代之,取而代之的是水槽增强型SWA,从而能够相继进行跨窗口边界的信息交流并缓解视觉分裂. 主要行和主要行之间的本地空间安全分层序列化,以支持沿两个空间轴传播信息。 最后,定期插入GA层,直接汇总全球背景。 这种设计大大降低了高分辨率视觉处理的计算成本,同时实现了与GA ViTs相仿的性能. 请参考He等人(2026年)的更多信息分析.
为了从零开始对MiMo-ViT进行预训,我们将它与一个小的预训LLM配对,并仅利用跨入目标在多模式理解数据上优化所产生的VLM. 这种简单的配方避免了对比性学习等辅助目标,使得预训高效而可扩展. 关键的是,LLM仍然可以训练,为ViT提供稳定,精密有意义的梯度. 在对超过4T图像符号进行预训后,MiMo-ViT学习了强烈的视觉表现并成为了MiMo-V2.6.

blocks.en: 2.3 Audio Encoder
blocks.zh: 2.3 音频编码器

blocks.en:
Audio encoding in MiMo-V2.6 consists of two stages: audio tokenization with the Audio Tokenizer, followed by patch encoding. The Audio Tokenizer encoder first processes log-mel spectrograms through a two-layer convolutional frontend that halves the
frame rate. The resulting sequence is then passed through a Transformer with a causal hybrid attention architecture that interleaves SWA and GA layers. SWA layers capture local temporal dependencies, while GA layers aggregate context across the full
preceding sequence. A subsequent downsampling convolution further halves the frame rate to 25 25 Hz, after which a 20-layer residual vector quantizer (RVQ) represents each frame as 20 20 discrete audio tokens. The Audio Tokenizer follows the training
recipe of MiMo-Audio ( Xiaomi, 2025 ) and is trained on 20 million hours of audio spanning speech, music, and other audio content.
blocks.zh:
MiMo-V2.6中的音频编码由两个阶段组成:音频符号化与音频调试器,再由补丁编码. Audio Tokenizer 编码器首先通过一个双层分解的前端处理log-mel分光克,该分光克将双层分解为:
帧率。 随后产生的序列会通过一个具有因果杂交的注意结构的变形器来传递,这种结构会将SWA和GA层相接. SWA地层捕捉到局部时间依赖性,而GA地层则在全局内层集合上下文
前一个序列。 之后的下取样再将帧率进一步减半到25个25个Hz,之后一个20层的残余向量分解器(RVQ)作为20个离散的音频符号代表每个帧. 音频调试器跟随训练
MiMo-Audio的配方(小米,2025年),并接受过2000万小时的语音、音乐和其他音频内容的培训。

blocks.en:
The audio patch encoder follows the architectural design of MiMo-Audio and is trained jointly with the text backbone. At each time step, the audio tokens are embedded using separate embedding tables, one per RVQ codebook, and the resulting embeddings
are summed to form a single frame representation. Every four consecutive frames are grouped into an audio patch and processed by a Transformer with bidirectional self-attention confined to that patch. The four output representations are then
concatenated and linearly projected into a single backbone input embedding, reducing the audio sequence rate from 25 25 Hz to 6.25 6.25 Hz.
blocks.zh:
音频补丁编码器遵循了MiMo-Audio的建筑设计,并与文本主干线共同培训. 每个步骤,音频符号都使用单独的嵌入表嵌入,每个RVQ代码簿一个,以及由此产生的嵌入
概括为形成单一框架代表。 每四个相接的相框被组合成一个音频补丁,由一变形器进行处理,其双向自发性局限于该补丁. 那四个产出说明就是了
被收缩并线性地投放为单一主干输入嵌入,将音频序列速率从25个25赫兹降低到6.25个6.25赫兹.

blocks.en: 2.4 Speculative Decoder
blocks.zh: 2.4 分光解码器

blocks.en:
Speculative decoding in MiMo-V2.6 uses a multi-token prediction (MTP) module following the block diffusion design of DFlash ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . The drafter comprises 5 Transformer layers with dense feed-forward networks. Conditioned on backbone hidden features and a clean anchor token, it predicts 7 subsequent tokens in a single forward pass for parallel verification by the backbone.
All draft layers use sliding-window attention (SWA) with grouped queries to limit attention computation and KV-cache size. Tokens attend bidirectionally within their draft block and to at most 1,024 1{,}024 backbone context positions preceding the anchor.
blocks.zh:
MiMo-V2.6中的分光分解在DFlash的块扩散设计(Chen等,2026年)后使用了多键预测(MTP)模块. 起草器由5个变压器层组成,并有密集的向导网络. 它以主干隐藏特征和一个干净的锚地符号为条件,在一次前行传中预言7个后行的指使,供主干平行验证.
所有草稿层都使用有分组查询的滑动窗口注意(SWA)来限制注意计算和KV-cache大小. Tokens在他们的分块草稿内双向参加,最多在锚前到达1,024 1{,}024个主干上下文位置.

blocks.en: 3 Pre-Training
blocks.zh: 3 培训前

blocks.en: 3.1 Pre-Training Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 培训前设置

blocks.en:
The pre-training corpus of MiMo-V2.6 spans text, vision, and audio. The text corpus draws from a broad range of sources, including public web content, books, academic papers, code, and STEM materials.
The vision corpus includes image-captioning, grounding, OCR, GUI, conversation, video, and visual-coding data.
For audio, we curate diverse, high-quality data at scale and organize the data into three task formats: speech-text interleaving, automatic speech recognition (ASR), and general audio captioning.
blocks.zh:
MiMo-V2.6的预训包括文字、视觉和音频。 文本集来源广泛,包括公共网站内容、书籍、学术论文、代码和STEM材料。
视觉元件包括图像封装、地面、OCR、GUI、对话、视频和可视编码数据。
对于音频,我们按规模对各种高质量的数据进行整理,并将数据组织为三种任务格式:语音文本互通,自动语音识别(ASR)和一般音频字幕.

blocks.en: We adopt a two-stage pre-training strategy. In the first stage, we train the language backbone on text-only data to establish strong foundational language capabilities. In the second stage, we integrate the backbone with our in-house pre-trained ViT and audio encoder and jointly train the full model on omni-modal data, enabling it to understand images, videos, and audio.
blocks.zh: 我们采取了两个阶段的培训前战略。 在第一阶段,我们培训语言主干在文本唯一数据上,以建立强大的基础语言能力。 在第二阶段,我们把骨干与我们内部预先训练的ViT和音频编码器整合在一起,并联合培训全方位模式数据,使其能够理解图像、视频和音频。

blocks.en:
We begin pre-training with a context length of 32K tokens and extend it to 256K partway through training.
MiMo-V2.6-Flash is trained on 48T tokens, comprising 26T tokens in the text stage and 22T in the omni stage. MiMo-V2.6-Pro is trained on 30T tokens, with 27T and 3T tokens in the two stages, respectively.
We employ the AdamW optimizer in the pre-training of MiMo-V2.6.
blocks.zh:
我们开始前期训练,上下文长度为32K令牌,并通过训练扩展到256K分道扬镳.
MiMo-V2.6-Flash接受过48T道具的训练,由文本舞台上26T道具和奥姆尼舞台上22T道具组成. MiMo-V2.6-Pro接受过30T道具的训练,两个阶段分别有27T道具和3T道具.
我们在MiMo-V2.6的预训中使用了AdamW优化器.

blocks.en: 3.2 Mid-Training Setup
blocks.zh: 3.2 中级培训设置

blocks.en: Pre-training builds broad knowledge and general understanding across text, vision, and audio. Mid-training bridges this general foundation and subsequent large-scale RL by further developing the model’s agentic abilities, extending long-context support, and adapting the optimization setup for large-batch training.
blocks.zh: 培训前积累了广泛的知识和对文本、愿景和音频的一般理解。 中期训练通过进一步发展模型的代理能力,扩展长编支持,并调整大批量训练的优化设置,将这一总基础和随后的大规模RL相接.

blocks.en:
To this end, we train the MiMo-V2.6 model series on a diverse, agent-centric data mixture. Its diversity spans both task domains and data modalities, combining realistic agent trajectories across coding, general, visual, and research tasks with high-quality text, repository-level code, and image, video, and audio data.
Training proceeds in two stages: we first train with a 256K context length, allocating the majority of compute to this stage, and then extend the context length to 1M in the final stage.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们培训了MiMo-V2.6模型系列,以多样化的、以物剂为中心的数据混合物。 其多样性跨越任务领域和数据模式,将跨越编码、一般、视觉和研究任务的现实代理轨迹与高质量的文本、寄存层编码以及图像、视频和音频数据结合起来。
训练分两个阶段进行:我们先用256K个上下文长度的列车,将计算的大部分分配到这个阶段,然后在最后阶段将上下文长度延长到1M.

blocks.en:
Our base model was pre-trained with AdamW, but our preliminary experiments showed diminishing optimization efficiency as the batch size increased in mixed-task RL.
Unlike AdamW, which adapts parameters element-wise, Muon leverages the matrix structure of hidden weights by orthogonalizing their updates ( Jordan et al., 2024 ) . This matrix-based update retains stronger data efficiency beyond the critical-batch-size regime, making Muon particularly attractive for large-batch training ( Liu et al., 2025b ; Shah et al., 2025 ) .
We therefore switch to a variant of Muon optimizer, Muown, for the hidden weight matrices during mid-training to prepare the model for subsequent large-batch RL. Muown augments Muon with explicit row-norm control, mitigating spectral-norm drift and reducing sensitivity to weight decay at negligible overhead ( Lion et al., 2026 ) . Embeddings, the LM head, and the MoE router continue to use AdamW.
blocks.zh:
我们的基型在亚当W之前就已经训练过,但我们的初步实验显示,随着混合任务RL的批量尺寸增加,优化效率正在下降.
与按参数元素调整参数的AdamW不同,Muon通过将隐藏的权重进行正向更新来利用其矩阵结构(Jordan等,2024年). 这种基于矩阵的更新保留了比临界批量规模制度更强的数据效率,使Muon对大型批量培训特别有吸引力(Liu等人,2025b;Shah等人,2025年)。
因此,我们转而使用Muon优化器的变体:Muown,用于中训期间隐藏的重量矩阵,为随后的大批RL准备模型. Muown通过明确的行 -- -- 规范控制来增强Muon,减轻光谱 -- -- 规范漂移,并降低在可忽略不计的间接费用上对重量衰减的敏感性(Lion等人,2026年)。 嵌入式,LM头和MOE路由器继续使用AdamW.

blocks.en:
Prior work reports that switching an Adam-pre-trained model to Muon training can cause optimizer mismatch and degraded performance ( Qu et al., 2026 ) .
Nevertheless, during our mid-training, we observe no loss spike throughout the training process.
blocks.zh:
先前的工作报告称,将亚当前所训练的模型切换到穆恩训练会导致优化不匹配和性能退化(Qu等,2026.).
尽管如此,在我们接受中期培训期间,在整个培训过程中,我们没有看到损失激增。

blocks.en: We employ MXFP4 quantization-aware training (QAT) during mid-training, allowing the model to adapt to low-precision computation while preserving model quality.
blocks.zh: 我们在中训期间使用MXFP4分数-认知训练(QAT),使模型在保持模型质量的同时能够适应低精度计算.

blocks.en: 4 Scaling Reinforcement Learning
blocks.zh: 4 强化学习

blocks.en:
In this release, we continue to push the boundaries of post-training algorithms, with a particular focus on scaling RL compute.
Following a short supervised fine-tuning (SFT) stage, we scale RL along three dimensions, training computation (§ 4.1 ), environments and agent harnesses (§ 4.2 ), and grader computation (§ 4.3 ), achieving a fundamental leap in model capabilities.
blocks.zh:
在本版中,我们继续推动训练后算法的分界线,尤其注重缩放RL计算.
在经过短期监督微调(SFT)阶段之后,我们按照三个维度、培训计算(§ 4.1)、环境和剂利用(§ 4.2)和分级器计算(§ 4.3)对RL进行分级,实现模型能力的根本飞跃。

blocks.en: 4.1 Scaling RL Training Computation
blocks.zh: 4.1 扩大RL培训计算

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Left: average@3 score on DeepSWE v1.1 versus cumulative RL cost. Right: training, rollout, and grader cost shares for MiMo-V2.6-Pro and MiMo-V2.6-Flash.
blocks.zh: 图3:左:DeepSWE v1.1对累计RL成本的平均分@3分. 右:MiMo-V2.6-Pro和MiMo-V2.6-Flash的训练、推广和分级费用份额。

blocks.en:
We scale RL computation across thousands of GPUs in a single run, spending $2.6M and $0.9M on RL post-training for MiMo-V2.6-Pro and MiMo-V2.6-Flash, respectively.
We use a large training batch: 1,568 prompts with group size G = 16 G{=}16 , so each step rolls out 25K sequences that amount to 2.7B–3.7B training tokens (roughly 110K–150K tokens per sequence).
The left panel of Figure 3 shows the benefit of scaling RL computation.
The average@3 score on the DeepSWE benchmark ( Huang and Jiang, 2026 ) rises steadily with cumulative cost for both models: over the course of RL, MiMo-V2.6-Pro improves from 58.4 58.4 to 72.6 72.6 and MiMo-V2.6-Flash from 48.7 48.7 to 65.7 65.7 .
The computation splits into three parts: rollout, grading, and training.
Such scaling calls for solid infrastructure to keep training efficient and stable.
blocks.zh:
我们在一次运行中将数千个GPU的RL计算规模放大,在MiMo-V2.6-Pro和MiMo-V2.6-Flash的RL后训练上分别花费了2.6M和0.9M.
我们使用一个大型的训练批次:1 568个带有G=16个GQQ16的提示,因此每步推出25K个序列,相当于2.7B–3.7B的训练活符(大约每序列110K–150K个活符).
图3左面板显示缩放RL计算的好处.
DeepSWE基准(黄和江,2026年)上的平均@3分稳步上升,两种模式的累计成本为:在RL过程中,MiMo-V2.6-Pro从58.4 58.4提高到72.6 72.6;MiMo-V2.6-Flash从48.7 48.7提高到65.7 65.7.
计算分为三个部分:推出、分级和培训。
这种规模的扩大需要坚实的基础设施,以保持培训的效率和稳定性。

blocks.en:
A large batch is good for scaling out GPUs: rollout parallelizes over sequences and training shards the batch across data-parallel ranks, so throughput grows with the GPU count.
With HBM mostly occupied by the running batch, we can keep a high arithmetic intensity to fully use the GPU in rollout.
Since rollout and grading have a long tail, we use partial rollout ( Kimi Team, 2025 ) to keep the running batch saturated: when we collect a training batch, we leave the in-flight sequences interrupted and resume them in the next rollout phase.
The cost is re-prefill: a continuation must rebuild its KV cache after each policy update, so batch size and partial rollout are chosen together—a large batch amortizes the re-prefill.
To support stable RL training, train–inference consistency is ensured by R3 ( Ma et al., 2025 ) and the replay of top- p sampling candidate sets ( Liu et al., 2025a ; The Microsoft AI Team, 2026 ) .
To ensure that all samples contribute to training with effective gradients, we incorporate a dynamic sampler ( Yu et al., 2025 ) to filter groups that are all-pass or all-fail.
In multi-task RL, we implement a Sample Mixer to ensure efficient and stable training batch distribution given various rollout durations and pass rates of different tasks.
To pack the trajectories from rollout into large training batches (2.7B–3.7B tokens), we decouple the data plane and control plane.
The infrastructure behind these designs is described in Section 6 .
blocks.zh:
大量批量对扩大GPU是好的:在序列上展开并列,在数据平行排位上训练将批量分解,因此吞吐量随GPU计数而增长.
由于HBM大多被运行的批量占用,我们可以保持高的算术强度来充分使用GPU来展开.
由于推出和分级有很长的尾巴,我们使用部分推出(Kimi Team,2025年)来保持运行的批次饱和:当收集出一批训练时,我们离开飞行中的序列被中断,并在下一个推出阶段恢复.
成本是重新预装的:每次更新政策后,续作必须重建其 KV 缓存,所以批量大小和部分推出一起选择——一个大批分期摊还重新预装.
为了支持稳定的RL培训,R3(Ma等,2025年)和重放顶级-p采样候选组合(Liu等,2025a;微软AI Team,2026年)确保了列车-推论的一致性.
为了确保所有样本都有助于有效梯度培训,我们采用了动态取样器(Yu等人,2025年)来过滤全程或全程故障的组别。
在多任务RL中,我们实施一个样本混合器,以确保高效而稳定的培训批次分配,因为不同任务的推出期限和通过率各不相同。
将轨迹从推出后打包入大型训练批次(2.7B–3.7B令牌),将数据平面与控制平面脱钩.
第6节叙述了这些设计背后的基础设施。

blocks.en: 4.2 Scaling RL Environments and Harnesses
blocks.zh: 4.2 扩大RL环境与利用

blocks.en:
Scaling agentic RL requires diverse environments that reflect real-world tasks, support reproducible execution at training scale, and provide rewards aligned with task objectives. Meeting these requirements jointly is challenging: realistic workflows involve heterogeneous tools and complex state, while automated graders may be incomplete, inconsistent, or vulnerable to exploitation. We therefore invest in large-scale environment synthesis and curation across coding (§ 4.2.1 ), general professional workflows (§ 4.2.2 ), visual artifacts (§ 4.2.3 ), and cybersecurity (§ 4.2.4 ), emphasizing supervision quality.
This subsection describes how we construct tasks and environments across these domains, the harnesses through which agents interact with them (§ 4.2.5 ), and the execution checks, rollout-based audits, and adversarial testing used to improve reward reliability and mitigate reward hacking before and during training (§ 4.2.6 ).
blocks.zh:
扩大代理RL需要不同的环境,能够反映现实世界的任务,支持在培训规模上可复制的执行,并提供符合任务目标的奖励. 共同满足这些要求具有挑战性:现实的工作流程涉及不同的工具和复杂的状态,而自动化分级器可能不完整、不一致或容易被利用。 因此,我们投资于大规模环境合成和校正(第4.2.1节)、一般专业工作流程(第4.2.2节)、视觉文物(第4.2.3节)和网络安全(第4.2.4节),强调监督质量。
本分节介绍我们如何构建跨越这些领域的任务和环境、代理人与其互动的渠道(第4.2.5节),以及用于提高奖励可靠性和减少培训前和培训期间奖励黑客行为的执行检查、推出审计和对抗性测试(第4.2.6节)。

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Code Agent Tasks
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 密码代理任务

blocks.en: Figure 4 : The overall code agent task scaling pipeline. We build tasks from diverse sources and go through rigorous assessment stages to ensure the supervision is accurate and robust.
blocks.zh: 图4:总体代码代理任务缩放管线. 我们从不同来源制定任务,并经历严格的评估阶段,以确保监督是准确和有力的。

blocks.en:
Coding tasks are particularly well suited to RL, as candidate solutions can be executed and evaluated through automated tests, providing feedback at scale.
However, executable evaluation alone does not guarantee reliable supervision: tests may overlook required behavior, reject valid implementations, or yield inconsistent outcomes across executions. The central challenge is therefore to scale task construction while ensuring that rewards faithfully reflect task correctness. Motivated by this, we devote substantial effort to building a scalable synthesis and curation pipeline for coding-agent tasks, with an emphasis on the accuracy and robustness of supervision. Figure 4 summarizes the task synthesis pathways and the checks used to assess supervision accuracy and robustness.
blocks.zh:
编码任务特别适合RL,因为候选解决方案可以通过自动化测试执行和评价,提供规模反馈.
然而,仅凭可执行评价并不能保证可靠的监督:测试可能忽略必要的行为,拒绝有效的执行,或在处决过程中产生不一致的结果。 因此,主要的挑战是在确保奖励忠实反映任务正确性的同时,扩大任务构建的规模。 以此为动力,我们作出大量努力,为编码代理任务建设可伸缩的合成和校正管道,强调监督的准确性和稳健性. 图4概述了任务综合路径和用于评估监督准确性和稳健性的检查。

blocks.en:
We scale task construction through five complementary synthesis pathways, designed to cover heterogeneous programming languages, development settings, and task horizons. First, in GitHub-based synthesis , we collect pull requests and their associated issues and apply heuristic and model-assisted filters to remove duplicate, malformed, or non-reproducible candidates. When a pull request is linked to an issue that provides a sufficiently complete description of the intended change, we use the issue as the task specification. Otherwise, an LLM reconstructs an issue-style specification from the reference patch and the surrounding repository context, while being explicitly instructed to omit implementation-specific details that could reveal the solution. Second, to capture everyday development workflows , including interactive “vibe coding” scenarios, we collect real-world development requests contributed by employees within our organization. These requests cover common activities such as feature implementation, refactoring, debugging, and repository maintenance, for which agents generate and implement test cases that operationalize the requested behavior. Third, specification-driven tasks emphasize code generation under detailed, multi-constraint requirements, allowing us to evaluate whether models can faithfully translate complex specifications into executable implementations. Fourth, in source-code-driven synthesis , we use CodeMidas ( Ye et al., 2026 ) to derive tasks from functionality implemented in existing codebases. Agents identify candidate functionality and translate its observable behavior into task specifications and executable environments, this pathway enables scalable task construction across diverse repositories without requiring issues, pull requests, or other development artifacts. For long-horizon software-engineering tasks , agents iteratively elaborate task requirements, expand the scope of the required changes, introduce dependencies across components, and construct tests that exercise the resulting multi-step behavior.
We also include and filter samples from public sources ( Tao et al., 2026 ; Badertdinov et al., 2026 ; Zan et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026b ; PrimeIntellect, 2026 ) and licensed data vendors to further enrich the task distribution. Collectively, these pathways produce tasks spanning a broad range of programming languages, development contexts, implementation complexities, and task horizons.
blocks.zh:
我们通过五个互补的合成途径来扩大任务构建,这些途径旨在涵盖不同的编程语言,开发环境以及任务视野. 首先,在基于GitHub的合成中,我们收集牵引请求及其相关问题,并应用Heuristic和模型辅助滤波器来去除重复的,畸形的,或不可复制的候选人. 当牵引请求与能够充分完整地描述预期变化的问题联系起来时,我们将该问题作为任务说明。 否则,LLM会从参考补丁和周围寄存器上下文中重建出一个问题式的规格,同时被明确指示省去可以揭示解决方案的具体执行细节. 第二,为了掌握日常发展工作流程,包括交互式的“虚拟编码”情景,我们收集了本组织内部雇员提出的现实世界发展请求。 这些请求涵盖共同活动,如特性执行,再造,调试,以及寄存器维护,为此代理生成并实施操作所请求的行为的测试案例. 第三,规格驱动的任务强调在详细,多约束的要求下生成代码,使我们能够评价模型是否能够忠实地将复杂的规格转化为可执行的执行. 第四,在源代码驱动的合成中,我们使用CodeMidas(Ye等,2026年)从现有代码库所执行的功能中得出任务. 代理人确定候选功能,并将其可观察到的行为转化为任务规格和可执行的环境,这一路径可以使不同储存库之间可扩展的任务构建无需问题、牵引请求或其他开发文物。 对于长视野软件-工程任务,代理商迭代地细化任务要求,扩大所需修改的范围,在组件之间引入依赖性,并构建能够进行由此而来多步骤行为的测试.
我们还包括并过滤来自公共来源的样本(Tao等,2026;Badertdinov等,2026;Zan等,2025;Zhao等,2026;Yang等,2026b;PrimeIntellect,2026)和特许数据供应商,以进一步丰富任务分布. 这些途径共同产生的任务涵盖广泛的编程语言、发展背景、执行的复杂性和任务范围。

blocks.en:
We align the behavioral scope of each task specification with that of its unit tests. The goal is to accept implementations that satisfy the specification and reject those that violate it, without requiring incidental details of the reference implementation. We review tasks for insufficient coverage and overly restrictive checks. In particular, tests that enforce requirements absent from the specification are revised or removed.
As inspection alone may miss discrepancies between specifications and tests, we further assess their alignment through rollout-based auditing. Each task is attempted four times by a coding agent. An auditing agent receives all four rollouts in a shared workspace containing the problem statement, tests, reference patch, and each rollout’s submitted patch, test output, and full conversation log. The auditor first articulates what a correct solution requires and assesses whether the tests capture those requirements. It then evaluates each submitted solution against the specification using its patch and conversation log, and compares this assessment with the observed reward. A passing solution judged incorrect is flagged as a potential false positive, suggesting incomplete verification. A failing solution judged correct is flagged as a potential false negative, suggesting overly restrictive tests or execution failures. These disagreements identify tasks requiring further review and provide concrete evidence of possible mismatches between the intended behavior and the implemented verification.
blocks.zh:
我们把每个任务规格的行为范围 与单位测试一致 目标是接受符合规格的执行,拒绝违反规格的执行,而不要求提供参考执行的附带细节。 我们审查各项任务,因为其覆盖面不足,而且检查过于严格。 特别是,修改或删除在规格中未执行要求的测试。
由于仅检查就可能错过规格和测试之间的差异,我们通过推出审计进一步评估其一致性。 每个任务都要经过四次编码代理尝试. 一个审计代理在一个共享的工作空间中接收所有四个推出,其中包括问题说明、测试、参考补丁,以及每个推出的补丁、测试输出和完整的谈话日志。 审计员首先阐述了正确解决办法的要求,并评估测试是否包含这些要求。 然后,它使用它的补丁和谈话日志,对照规格评估每个提交的解决方案,并将这种评估与观察到的奖励进行比较。 被判定为不正确的通过的解决办法被标注为潜在的虚假积极性,表明核查不完整。 被判定为正确的失败解决方案被标为潜在的虚假否定,表明测试或执行失败的限制性过强。 这些分歧确定了需要进一步审查的任务,并提供了预期行为与已实施的核查之间可能不匹配的具体证据。

blocks.en:
We check reward stability through repeated execution. For those tasks with reference patch, we ensure fail-to-pass (F2P) tests must fail and pass-to-pass (P2P) tests must pass before applying the reference patch; after the patch, both must pass. We require these outcomes to remain stable across eight reruns, screening for flaky tests and environment-induced reward fluctuations.
We also reuse the previous rollout pipeline to collect agent trajectories to investigate potential reward hacking. The submitted patches and conversation logs provide evidence of how agents obtained their rewards, helping identify unintended shortcuts or exploitation of the environment and evaluation process. These checks complement the assessment of solution correctness and inform the broader reward-hacking mitigation procedures described below.
blocks.zh:
我们通过反复处决来检查奖励的稳定。 对于带有参考补丁的这些任务,我们保证故障通取(F2P)测试必须失败,通过通取(P2P)测试必须在应用参考补丁前通过;补丁后,两者都必须通过. 我们要求这些结果在8次重新运行中保持稳定,筛选出片状测试和环境引起的奖励波动。
我们还重新使用之前的推出管道 收集代理轨迹 调查潜在的奖励黑客。 提交的补丁和谈话日志提供了代理人如何获得奖励的证据,有助于确定意外的捷径或对环境的利用和评价过程。 这些检查是对解决方案正确性评估的补充,并为下文所述的更广泛的奖励性缓解程序提供信息。

blocks.en: Together, these procedures support the construction of a diverse coding-task corpus under a consistent standard of supervision quality. Specification–test alignment targets the fidelity of the reward signal, repeated execution checks its stability, and rollout-based auditing probes whether it agrees with an independent assessment of solution correctness. Our objective is to make this combination scalable, so that RL training can benefit from broad task coverage while encouraging agents to satisfy the intended requirements rather than exploit gaps in evaluation.
blocks.zh: 这些程序共同支持在一致的监督质量标准下建立一个多样化的编码任务组。 规格测试对接的目标是奖励信号的忠实性,重复执行检查其稳定性,以及推出审计调查是否同意对解决方案正确性进行独立评估。 我们的目标是使这种组合具有可扩展性,以便远程教育培训能够从广泛的任务范围中受益,同时鼓励代理人满足预期要求,而不是利用评价中的空白。

blocks.en: 4.2.2 General Agent Tasks
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 总代理任务

blocks.en:
Figure 5 : The overall general-agent environment and verifiable-task synthesis pipeline. We first construct realistic, resettable environments from real-world files and software mocks. Agents then
explore these environments and synthesize tasks with verifiable rubrics.
blocks.zh:
图5:总体一般代理环境和可核查任务合成管线. 我们首先从现实世界的文件和软件模拟中构建现实的,可重置的环境. 那么,探员们
探索这些环境,并用可核查的标题来合成任务.

blocks.en: We extend agent capabilities to real-world professional workflows across diverse domains, whose workflows require agents to analyze heterogeneous documents, use specialized software, and produce deliverables that meet domain-specific standards. We synthesize environments that support such workflows, then construct challenging tasks with verifiable outcomes. Figure 5 summarizes this pipeline, including environment construction, task synthesis, and iterative rubric refinement.
blocks.zh: 我们把代理能力扩展到不同领域的现实世界专业工作流程,其工作流程要求代理分析各种文件,使用专门软件,并产生符合特定领域标准的可交付成果。 我们综合了支持这些工作流程的环境,然后构建具有可核查结果的挑战性任务。 图5概括了这一管道,包括环境建设、任务综合和迭代标题改进。

blocks.en: A general-agent environment typically consists of a workspace and a set of software tools, accessible through interfaces such as MCP, APIs, CLIs, and GUIs. Our design balances realism with the requirements of large-scale RL: files, software behavior, and underlying data should reflect professional practice, while execution must remain local and environments must be easy to reset. We therefore collect real-world files for direct inclusion or as references for synthesis, and use an automated multi-agent workflow to build local software mocks that reproduce supported operations, state changes, output formats, and error responses. Tools that already operate without external services are integrated directly. All state is stored locally, and each rollout runs in an isolated sandbox that can be restored to a fixed initial state. This avoids network variability and service limits while supporting reproducible execution.
blocks.zh: 一般代理环境一般由工作空间和一套软件工具组成,通过MCP,API,CLI,GUI等接口可以访问. 我们的设计平衡了现实主义和大规模RL的要求:文件,软件行为,以及基础数据应该反映专业实践,而执行必须保持局部,环境必须容易被重置. 因此,我们收集现实世界文件,以便直接纳入或用作合成参考,并使用一个自动的多代理工作流程来构建本地软件来模拟复制支持的操作,状态变化,输出格式和错误反应. 没有外部服务已经运行的工具直接被集成. 所有状态都在当地存储,每次推出都运行在一个孤立的沙盒中,可以被恢复到固定的初始状态. 这在支持可再生执行的同时避免了网络可变性和服务限制.

blocks.en: To assemble these components into coherent scenarios, a planning agent specifies the workspace structure, selects appropriate tools, and plans file and database contents. Web search grounds the plan in real-world information, while relationships across files and between files and database records support subsequent multi-hop reasoning and cross-validation. Multiple agents then generate files and populate databases in parallel, following the shared plan and each mock’s data specification. A review agent checks individual artifacts and global consistency, including entity names, numerical reconciliation, timelines, and references. Iterative repair resolves inconsistencies before task construction. The workspace and tool configuration vary by scenario, so each environment reflects the relevant working practices without requiring every available file type or software interface.
blocks.zh: 为了将这些组件组合成一致的情景,规划代理人规定了工作空间结构,选择了适当的工具,并规划了文件和数据库内容。 网络搜索将计划建立在现实世界信息中,而跨文件的关系以及文件与数据库记录的关系则支持之后的多跳推理和交叉验证. 多个代理然后按照共享计划和每个模拟器的数据规格并行生成文件并输入数据库. 审查机构检查单个文物和全球一致性,包括实体名称、数字调节、时限和参考。 迭代修复在任务构建前解决了不一致的问题. 工作空间和工具配置因情景而异,因此每个环境都反映了相关的工作做法,而不需要每个可用的文件类型或软件接口.

blocks.en: We survey common professional tasks and combine and generalize them into seed tasks. An agent explores each environment and uses these seeds to construct tasks suited to its contents and tools. Task completion is evaluated using atomic, binary rubric items: code-based checks verify deterministic properties, such as database values and deliverable formats, while LLM-based checks assess more open-ended content. For LLM-based items, agreement across repeated judgments by the same model and across different judge models helps identify ambiguity.
blocks.zh: 我们调查共同的专业任务,将它们合并和概括为种子任务。 一个代理人探索每一种环境,并利用这些种子构建适合其内容和工具的任务. 任务完成使用原子,二进制符号进行评价:基于代码的检查验证确定性,如数据库值和可交付格式,而基于LLM的检查则评估更多可开放的内容. 对于基于LLM的项目,通过同一模式的反复判决和不同的法官模式达成一致有助于确定模糊性。

blocks.en: Consistency alone does not establish that rubrics capture task completion. We therefore collect rollouts from models with different capability levels and have a review agent examine their trajectories, execution results, and rubric judgments. The reviewer revises overly restrictive criteria that reject valid solutions and overly permissive criteria that accept incomplete ones. To test resistance to reward hacking, we include negative checks for unintended changes to unrelated files or databases and construct adversarial solutions that appear correct without actually solving the task. During RL, a self-hosted MiMo-V2.6-SFT model serves as the grader to support stable scoring. This process yields thousands of environments and diverse, verifiable tasks, which we combine with other tasks for RL training.
blocks.zh: 仅靠一致性并不能确定标题可以捕捉任务完成. 因此,我们从不同能力水平的模型中收集推广结果,并由一个审查代理人检查其轨迹、执行结果和标题判断。 审查者修改了限制性过强的标准,拒绝有效解决办法,并修改了接受不完整解决办法的过于宽容的标准。 为了测试对奖励黑客的抵制,我们包括对无意更改无关文件或数据库的负面检查,并构建似乎正确的对抗性解决方案而不实际解决任务. 在RL期间,一个自办的MiMo-V2.6-SFT模型充当了支持稳定分数的分数. 这一过程产生了上千个环境以及多种多样,可核查的任务,我们把这些任务与其他任务结合起来进行远程培训。

blocks.en: 4.2.3 Visual Agent Tasks
blocks.zh: 4.2.3 视觉代理任务

blocks.en: To empower agents to shape the digital world through creative expression and precise visual control, we curate a diverse suite of visual tasks in which agents work with a broad range of artifacts, such as websites, interactive applications, games, 3D scenes, slides, SVG, videos and Figma designs. We organize these tasks into two complementary categories: open-ended design and high-fidelity visual replication. Together, they develop the model’s ability to produce reliable implementations with strong aesthetic quality and precise visual control.
blocks.zh: 为了赋予代理通过创意表达和精确的视觉控制来塑造数字世界的能力,我们整理出一套多种多样的视觉任务,其中代理与各种文物合作,如网站,交互式应用程序,游戏,3D场景,幻灯片,SVG,视频和Figma设计. 我们把这些任务分为两个互补的类别:开放式设计和高真能视觉复制. 他们一起发展了模型的能力,以强大的审美质量和精确的视觉控制来产生可靠的执行.

blocks.en: Open-ended design seeks to produce aesthetically compelling visual artifacts that satisfy user intent. The diversity of valid creative solutions makes aesthetic quality difficult to capture through fixed rules alone. We therefore combine pointwise and groupwise grading to establish consistent quality standards while rewarding relative improvements in aesthetic quality. Specifically, we first iteratively refine pointwise rubrics for runtime correctness, instruction adherence, layout integrity, and basic aesthetic quality. Once these rubrics stabilize, we introduce groupwise grading that jointly compares the rendered artifacts within each rollout group for the same query, identifying clearly stronger and weaker candidates and assigning rewards accordingly.
blocks.zh: 开放式设计旨在生产具有美学说服力的能满足用户意图的视觉文物. 有效的创造性解决方案的多样性使得美学质量难以仅通过固定规则来捕捉. 因此,我们把分级和分级结合起来,建立一致的质量标准,同时奖励美学质量的相对改善。 具体地说,我们首先迭代地精炼出指向点, 用于运行时间的正确性,指令的坚持性,布局的完整性,以及基本的美学质量。 一旦这些主题稳定下来,我们将采用分组分级法,共同比较每个推出组中制作的文物,以便进行同样的查询,找出明显强弱的候选人,并相应给予奖励。

blocks.en: High-fidelity visual replication aims to faithfully reproduce a specified visual target. Compared to open-ended design, the explicit reference enables more direct evaluation of visual fidelity. We grade these tasks primarily through rule-based similarity metrics, such as pixel-level similarity between rendered artifacts and their references, supplemented by LLM-based judging for holistic visual assessment. Together, these signals support effective scaling of reinforcement learning on visual replication tasks.
blocks.zh: 高性能视觉复制旨在忠实地复制指定的视觉目标. 与开放式设计相比,明确提及可以更直接地评价视觉忠诚。 我们主要通过基于规则的相似性衡量标准来分级这些任务,例如像素水平的相似性在制成的文物与它们的参考文献之间,辅之以基于LLM的判断,以进行整体的视觉评估. 这些信号共同支持了视觉复制任务强化学习的有效规模.

blocks.en: 4.2.4 Cybersecurity Agent Tasks
blocks.zh: 4.2.4 网络安全代理任务

blocks.en:
We train cyber agents with RL on real-world vulnerability reproduction: given a project and a target bug,
the agent must construct an input that triggers it. This foundational offensive-security skill underlies
exploit development, privilege escalation, and CTF challenges. It is also well suited to RL at scale:
OSS-Fuzz supplies tens of thousands of manually confirmed instances, a volume unmatched by other
security tasks. The
difficulty is not triggering a crash, since complex C/C++ projects expose dozens of reachable crash
paths, but triggering the specific vulnerability described. Verification must therefore separate the
intended bug from unrelated crashes, and because it doubles as the RL reward, it must be accurate,
deterministic, and cheap.
blocks.zh:
我们用RL训练网络特工 研究真实世界的弱点复制: 给一个项目和一个目标bug,
代理人必须构建一个触发它的输入. 这种基本的进攻性安全技能是基础
利用发展、特权升级和真相和友谊委员会的挑战。 它也非常适合规模的RL:
OSS-Fuzz 提供数以万计的人工确认病例,这一数量与其它
安全任务。 这个
困难不会引发崩溃,因为复杂的 C/C++ 项目暴露出数十起可以达到的崩溃
路径,但触发所描述的具体脆弱性。 因此,核查必须分开:
从无关的相撞中产生的错误 因为它是RL奖励的两倍 所以它必须是准确的
有决定力,又便宜

blocks.en:
Existing oracles fall short. Fix-binary differential testing , as used in CyberGym ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , accepts a PoC that crashes
the vulnerable binary but not the patched one; an incomplete patch rejects correct PoCs, and unrelated
changes between the two commits flip verdicts for reasons unconnected to the bug. Either error corrupts the
training gradient. LLM-based judging returns different verdicts for the same PoC across runs and
cannot serve as a stable reward. We instead extract two attributes from the ground-truth sanitizer
(ASan/MSan/UBSan) report: the vulnerability type (e.g., heap-buffer-overflow) and the crash
location (the topmost project-level stack frame). A PoC is accepted iff its crash matches both under
rule-based string matching, which is deterministic, reproducible, and computationally trivial. The task
description is derived from the same report, stating the exact type and function in which the crash must
occur, so description and verification share a single source of truth; CyberGym’s LLM-generated
descriptions, by contrast, are often too broad (e.g., “buffer overflow in libxml2”) or simply wrong.
blocks.zh:
现存甲骨文不足. 在CyberGym(Wang等,2025年)中使用的固定-二进制差分测试,
脆弱二进制,但不是补丁; 不完整补丁拒绝正确的 PoCs , 而无关
由于与错误无关的原因, 两者之间的更改会执行翻转裁决 。 任何错误都会损坏
培训梯度。 基于 LLM 的判断返回了对同一 PoC 的不同判决横跨和
不能作为稳定的奖励。 我们从地真消毒器中提取出两个属性
(Asan/MSan/UBsan)报告:脆弱性类型(如堆积-缓冲-溢出)和坠毁
位置(最顶级的项目级堆栈框架)。 如果崩溃状态符合以下两种情况,则接受 PoC
基于规则的字符串匹配,它具有决定性,可再生产,且在计算上微不足道. 任务
描述来源于同一报告,说明坠机必须的确切类型和功能
因此,描述和核实共享一个真理来源; CyberGym 的 LLM 生成
相比之下,描述往往过于宽泛(例如“libxml2中的缓冲”)或完全错误。

blocks.en:
For each vulnerability we check out the source at the reported commit, build the fuzzing harness, and give
the agent the complete runtime environment: full source plus the compiled harness binary. CyberGym
withholds the binary, restricting agents to source-only analysis; providing it mirrors real vulnerability
analysis, where a researcher runs the target under a debugger, inspects memory, and crafts mutations from
runtime observations.
blocks.zh:
对于每一个脆弱性,我们检查报告承诺的来源,建立模糊的绳子,并给予
整个运行时间环境的代理:全源和编译的带子二进制。 网络游戏
保留二进制, 将代理限制在只进行源分析; 提供它反映真实的脆弱性
分析,如果研究人员在调试器下运行目标,则检查内存,以及来自
运行时间观测。

blocks.en: 4.2.5 Multi-Harness Training
blocks.zh: 4.2.5 多声道训练

blocks.en: Agent harnesses differ in module design and are selected or built to meet different application needs. Models must therefore adapt to diverse interaction mechanisms, including those of harnesses unseen during training, making cross-harness generalization an important capability.
blocks.zh: 代理吊带在模块设计上有所不同,是为满足不同的应用需要而选择或建造的. 因此,模型必须适应各种互动机制,包括培训过程中未见的利用机制,使跨机能通用成为一个重要的能力。

blocks.en: Training exclusively within a single harness may couple task-solving strategies to harness-specific implementations and limiting transfer. We therefore treat harness diversity as an additional training dimension alongside diversity in tasks and environments. A natural approach is to train on several production harnesses such as MiMo Code and Codex. However, this is a poor fit for RL in practice. First, production harnesses wrap the agent loop with engineering safeguards and multi-step workflows, and steer the model with numerous constraint and instruction prompts. These extras fall outside the task-completion reward signal, making credit assignment unreliable and leaving reward-unmeasured requirements to simply be ignored. Second, their modules are tightly coupled rather than independently configurable, so one cannot vary a single interaction mechanism in isolation or assemble diversity by controlled recombination.
blocks.zh: 完全通过单一手段进行的培训可以结合任务解决战略,以利用具体执行和限制转让。 因此,我们把利用多样性与任务和环境的多样性一起作为额外的培训内容。 一种自然的方法是培训一些生产工具,如MiMo Code和Codex。 然而,实际上,这是不适合再培训的。 首先,生产利用工程保障和多步骤工作流程将代理循环包裹起来,并以众多约束和指令提示来引导模型. 这些额外款项不在任务完成奖励信号之外,使信贷分配不可靠,使未计量的奖励要求被忽视。 第二,它们的模块紧密地组合起来,而不是可以独立配置的,因此人们不能在孤立的情况下改变单一的交互机制,也不能通过有控制的重组来组装多样性.

blocks.en: To this end, we propose multi-harness training with carefully designed mini-harnesses. All mini-harnesses start from the same minimal agent loop, which already includes the components needed for task completion—system prompt, tools, and context management. These modules stay minimal and decoupled, so implementations can be freely recombined and harness expansion remains controllable, safe, and clean. We then derive diverse, task-adapted mini-harness configurations for Code, General, Visual, and Cyber. The resulting training distribution is diverse yet controllable, supporting analysis of individual harness mechanisms and encouraging transferable task-solving strategies.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们提议用精心设计的小型机车进行多机车训练。 所有小型设施都从相同的最小代理循环开始,该循环已经包括完成任务所需的组件——系统即时、工具和上下文管理。 这些模块保持最小程度并脱钩,因此可以自由地重新组合实施,而利用的扩展仍然可以控制、安全和清洁。 然后,我们为代码、通用、视觉和Cyber得出了多样化的、经过任务调整的小型设施配置。 由此产生的培训分布多种多样,但可加以控制,支持对单个利用机制的分析,并鼓励可转移的任务解决战略。

blocks.en: 4.2.6 Reward Hacking Mitigation
blocks.zh: 4.2.6 减轻损失

blocks.en:
Table 2: Representative reward-hacking cases in repository-repair tasks.
In this setting, retrieving existing fixes outside the assigned checkout
bypasses the intended repair task.
Task queries are summarized, thinking excerpts are quoted verbatim, and
actions are abbreviated. Each row comes from a single rollout.
blocks.zh:
表2:在仓库维修任务中代表奖励案件。
在此设置中, 获取指定退出以外的现有修正
绕过预定的修复任务。
对任务查询进行总结,逐字引用思考摘要,

blocks.en:
RL relies on rewards to measure task success, but agents can sometimes earn high rewards by exploiting the environment or the evaluation process. This behavior, known as reward hacking, can be reinforced during training, increasing scores without improving task performance.
For common coding agent tasks like repository-repair, a recurring failure mode is solution
leakage : agents obtain a published fix beyond the intended task context and
use it to construct a patch. Table 2 links each
task request to the agent’s stated intent and subsequent action across five
repositories. Such behavior can satisfy the test-based reward without
demonstrating that the agent derived the repair from the bug report and the
assigned checkout.

blocks.en: In early experiments, we observed a tendency toward reward hacking in MiMo. To mitigate this behavior, we synthesized a set of training examples from these cases and included them in mid-training. For each case, MiMo reflects on the faulty reasoning, revises the relevant turn, and continues with actions grounded in the task specification. The revised reasoning keeps the original error recognizable and makes the correction explicit. We found that adding these examples improved the model’s alignment.
blocks.zh: 在早期的实验中,我们观察到一种奖励黑客在米莫的倾向. 为了减轻这种行为,我们综合了从这些案件中得出的一套培训实例,并将它们纳入中期培训。 对于每个案例,MiMo都反思了错误的推理,修改了相关的转折,继续采取基于任务规格的行动. 修改后的推理保留了原出错的可辨认性,并明确校正. 我们发现,增加这些例子改进了模型的对接。

blocks.en: In coding tasks, agents may pass tests by recovering leaked solutions from the environment or retrieving existing solutions over the network. Building a project with the reference patch applied during environment construction can leave behind artifacts that reveal the solution. We therefore remove build logs, verifier outputs, residual patches, and project-generated binaries or bytecode that could expose it. We also clean caches that may contain solution information, including those outside the repository, while preserving third-party dependencies needed for offline rebuilding. For every task, we retain Git history up to and including the base commit, removing later commits and their associated references. We enforce container-level network isolation to restrict access to upstream fixes and alternative package versions that may contain the solution. These safeguards are accompanied by explicit instructions against retrieving existing solutions or bypassing the required implementation.
blocks.zh: 在编码任务中,代理商可能通过从环境中取回被泄露的溶液或通过网络取回已存在的溶液来通过测试. 用环境建设期间应用的参考补丁来建设项目,可以留下揭示溶液的文物. 因此,我们删除了建构日志,验证输出,剩余补丁,以及项目生成的二进制或字节代码,从而可以曝光. 我们还清理可能包含解决方案信息的缓存,包括存储库以外的信息,同时保留离线重建所需的第三方依赖性. 对于每一项任务,我们保留了基特历史直至并包括基础承诺,去除后期承诺及其相关引用. 我们实施集装箱级网络隔离,以限制获取上游补救和可能包含解决方案的替代软件包版本。 在采取这些保障措施的同时,还明确指示不得收回现有解决办法或绕过所要求的执行。

blocks.en: A dedicated hack agent then probes the prepared environments for remaining leaks and exploitable weaknesses. We guide its search with examples from early experiments, including recovering solutions from cached artifacts or preinstalled copies of the target project. The agent checks these known routes while searching for new ones. It uncovered many exploit paths that we had not observed during training and that our existing cleanup procedures did not cover. We use these findings to refine cleanup and access restrictions, then rerun the hack agent on the updated environments. These subsequent checks repeatedly exposed further weaknesses, requiring additional rounds of cleanup and testing. We continued this process until the hack agent could no longer find a successful exploit in any of the environments.
blocks.zh: 一个专门的黑客代理 然后探究 准备的环境 剩下的泄漏和可开发的弱点。 我们以早期实验的例子指导其搜索,包括从缓存文物中取回解决方案或预定目标项目副本。 特工在寻找新路线时检查这些已知路线. 它揭示了我们在培训期间没有看到的许多利用途径,我们现有的清理程序没有涵盖这些途径。 我们利用这些发现来完善清理和准入限制,然后在更新的环境中重新运行黑客代理. 这些随后进行的检查一再暴露出进一步的弱点,需要更多的清理和测试。 我们继续这个过程,直到黑客特工在任何环境下都找不到成功的利用.

blocks.en: We regularly audit agent trajectories offline for reward hacking throughout training. As the policy evolves, it may discover shortcuts that were not found during adversarial screening. We use these observations to identify weaknesses in the environments and guide further cleanup and access restrictions. Alongside these offline audits, the groupwise agentic grader (Section 4.3.2 ) sets the effective reward of confirmed hacking trajectories to zero before recomputing group statistics and advantages. With this correction in place, the logged confirmed-hack share remains below 2 % 2\% throughout the whole training process for both MiMo-V2.6-Flash and MiMo-V2.6-Pro (Figure 6 ).

blocks.en: 4.3 Groupwise Agentic Grading
blocks.zh: 4.3 分组代理级

blocks.en: For code agent tasks, binary test rewards provide a scalable correctness signal but do not distinguish implementation quality or problem-solving behavior among passing solutions. We use two complementary methods on distinct subsets of these tasks. Groupwise Reward Synthesis (GRS) is used for a subset of high-passrate tasks. It compares multiple offline rollouts to construct task-specific rubrics, which are reused during training to score individual rollouts and combine their quality scores with test rewards. For all the remaining code agent tasks, we rely primarily on Groupwise Advantage Redistribution (GAR) ( Dong et al., 2026 ) . Its online agentic grader jointly examines successful and failed trajectories within each mixed-outcome group, ranks passing solutions, and redistributes positive advantage toward higher-quality passing trajectories. Figure 7 summarizes both workflows.
blocks.zh: 对于代码代理任务,二进制测试奖励提供了可伸缩的正确性信号,但不区分执行质量或通过解决方案的解决问题行为. 我们对这些任务的不同部分使用两种互补方法。 Groupwise Reward Syndrome (GRS) 用于一子集高通率任务. 它比较了多个离线推出来构建任务特有名词,这些名词在训练期间被再用来评分个人推出,并将其质量分数与测试奖励相结合. 对于所有剩余的代码代理任务,我们主要依靠Groupwise Advantage Redistration(GAR)(Dong等,2026年). 它的在线代理分级器联合审查每个混合结果组中的成功和失败的轨迹,对通过的解决办法进行排名,并重新分配对高质量通过轨迹的积极优势。 图7概述了这两个工作流程。

(b) Groupwise advantage redistribution compares trajectories online, resets confirmed-hack rewards to zero, and redistributes sequence-level advantages. Bars schematically illustrate the redistribution of positive advantage from lower- to higher-quality passing solutions.

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Groupwise Reward Synthesis (GRS, Offline Rubrics)
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 分组奖励合成(GRS,离线Rubrics)

blocks.en: For each selected task, we collect multiple offline rollouts and ask an agent to study them together with the task specification and repository. Comparing these attempts exposes different solution approaches, recurring mistakes, and useful behaviors that may be distributed across several trajectories. The agent turns this analysis into two sets of criteria: solution rubrics, which assess the resulting implementation, and behavior rubrics, which assess how the agent approaches and verifies its work.

blocks.en: Solution rubrics describe task-relevant properties of a good implementation, including satisfaction of the requirements, appropriate handling of edge cases, and changes consistent with the surrounding codebase. Behavior rubrics describe observable practices that support reliable problem solving, such as gathering relevant evidence and checking the effects of code changes. We seek criteria that distinguish meaningful differences in quality while allowing different valid approaches to the task.
blocks.zh: 解决方案主题描述一个良好执行的任务相关属性,包括满足要求,适当处理边缘案件,以及符合周围代码库的修改. 行为标点描述支持可靠解决问题的可观察做法,例如收集相关证据并检查代码变化的效果. 我们寻求标准,以区别在质量上有意义的差异,同时允许对这项任务采取不同的有效办法。

blocks.en: The sampled rollouts inform rubric construction, but the criteria are grounded in the task itself. A useful behavior may appear in only one attempt, and a requirement supported by the task may be absent from every observed solution. The agent can therefore identify improvements beyond those demonstrated in the sampled rollouts. At the same time, a choice made by one successful solution does not automatically become a requirement for all others.
blocks.zh: 抽样的推出为标的构建提供信息,但标准基于任务本身。 一项有用的行为可能只出现在一次尝试中,每个观察到的解决方案都可能缺少一项任务支持的要求. 因此,该剂可以确定超出抽样推出所显示的改进。 同时,一个成功的解决办法作出的选择不会自动成为所有其他办法的要求。

blocks.en: The resulting rubrics are reused to evaluate subsequent training rollouts individually. A grader agent enters each rollout’s execution environment and assesses it against the task-specific rubrics, using the resulting code, execution results, and trajectory as evidence. It assigns a solution score S sol S^{\mathrm{sol}} for the quality of the implementation and a behavior score S beh S^{\mathrm{beh}} for how the agent approached and verified its work.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的主题被重新使用,以单独评估随后的培训展开情况。 一个分级代理进入每个推开的执行环境,并用结果的代码、执行结果和轨迹作为证据,根据任务特定标题进行评估。 它为执行的质量分配了一个解决方案分S sol S-^{\mathrm{sol}},为代理如何接近和验证其工作分配了一个行为分S beh S-^{\mathrm{beh}}.

blocks.en: For trajectory i i , let R i test R_{i}^{\mathrm{test}} denote the original binary test reward. We synthesize the final training reward by multiplying this test reward by the two rubric scores: R i = R i test ⋅ S i sol ⋅ S i beh . R_{i}=R_{i}^{\mathrm{test}}\cdot S_{i}^{\mathrm{sol}}\cdot S_{i}^{\mathrm{beh}}. (2) This multiplicative form keeps rubric supervision tied to test outcomes. Failed trajectories retain zero reward, while passing trajectories are further distinguished by implementation quality and problem-solving behavior. Even when every rollout in a group passes the tests, differences in the product of the two rubric scores can still provide a learning signal. The offline task analysis thus becomes a reusable source of supervision, allowing training to capture quality differences that binary test rewards leave unexpressed.

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Groupwise Advantage Redistribution (GAR, Online Grading)
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 集团优势再分配(GAR,在线升级)

blocks.en: We apply online groupwise advantage redistribution to the remaining code agent tasks. For each mixed-outcome rollout group, we place all trajectories in a shared workspace containing the task specification, repository, submitted patches, and test outputs. An SFT-trained agentic grader jointly examines all trajectories within the group, contrasting successful and failed attempts and comparing passing patches along five dimensions: the suitability of the solution approach, precision in implementing that approach without omissions or unnecessary fallbacks, minimality relative to the necessary changes, avoidance of unintended effects outside the task, and craftsmanship consistent with codebase conventions. These assessments guide the groupwise ranking, with ties when differences are inconclusive. The grader can inspect repository code and run targeted tests to better understand the task and verify candidate solutions. When evidence confirms dependence on an external or leaked answer, we reset the trajectory’s effective reward to zero and treat it as a failure before recomputing group statistics.
blocks.zh: 我们把在线的优势再分配 用于剩下的代码代理任务。 对于每个混合结果推出组,我们将所有轨迹放入包含任务规格,寄存器,提交的补丁以及测试输出的共享工作空间. SFT训练有素的代理分级器联合检查了组内的所有轨迹,对比成功和失败的尝试,并按五个方面比较过路的补丁:解决方案方法是否合适,在不遗漏或不必要倒计时的情况下精确实施该方法,相对于必要改变的最小程度,避免任务外的出乎意料的效果,以及符合编码基础公约的手工艺。 这些评估指导了分组排名,当分歧没有定论时,则有联系。 分级员可以检查寄存器代码并进行有针对性的测试,以更好地理解任务并验证候选解决方案. 当证据证实了对外部或泄露的答案的依赖时,我们将轨迹的有效奖励重新设定为零,并在重算群体统计数据之前将其视为失败。

blocks.en: To assess the effect of online groupwise advantage redistribution on training dynamics, we compare code-only RL runs of MiMo-V2.6-Flash with and without it, using a training batch size of 128 and token-mean loss aggregation (Figure 8 ). Without online grading, turns and total token length grow rapidly, causing more trajectories to hit the length limit, making it difficult to sustain improvements in pass rate. With online grading, pass-rate gains are sustained through step 52, while turn counts remain roughly stable and token length grows gradually. These trends suggest that online grading supports continued policy improvement under a more stable training regime.
blocks.zh: 为了评估在线分组优势再分配对培训动态的影响,我们用128个培训批量大小和象征性-平均损失汇总(图8),将MiMo-V2.6-Flash的只代码的RL运行与无代码进行对比。 没有在线分级,转弯和总符号长度会迅速增长,导致更多的轨迹冲击长度限制,使得通过率的提高难以持续. 通过在线分级,通过第52步,过分率收益得以维持,而转数则大致保持稳定,象征性长度逐渐增加。 这些趋势表明,在线评级有助于在更稳定的培训制度下继续改进政策。

blocks.en: Separate maintainer-oriented audits found that, under pressure to improve test pass rates, policies trained without online grading increasingly adopted undesirable behaviors such as speculative compatibility branches, broad exports, exception swallowing, relaxed validation, and evaluation-specific configuration changes. These workarounds aim to increase the likelihood of passing test but can exceed the scope of the task instructions, expand APIs unnecessarily, obscure failures, and make the code harder to maintain. In contrast, policies trained with online grading tended to produce smaller, more precise patches that remained within the requested scope and were easier to maintain.

blocks.en: To improve RL training stability and encourage efficient, reliable behavior, we introduce two complementary mechanisms. A group-relative length penalty curbs excessive token growth, while segment-level behavioral penalties address format violations and tool call errors. Batch-level advantage rebalancing improves credit assignment while limiting excess negative optimization pressure that can drive uncontrolled entropy growth.

blocks.en: 5.1 Training Setup

blocks.en:
Our RL tasks span various domains, including agentic and competitive coding (68%), general tool use (12%), aesthetic design (13%), context following (3%), and cyber security (4%).
We sample a prompt batch of 1568 with 16 rollouts per prompt, totaling a global train batch of 25K trajectories.
Training uses GRPO with asynchronous partial rollouts at a staleness of 4.

我们抽取了1568个快速批次,每个快速批次有16个推出站,共计25K个轨距的全球列车批次.
训练使用GPRO,在4分时同步部分推出.

blocks.en: We evaluate agentic capabilities across four categories: code agent, cybersecurity, general agent, and visual agent. Our evaluation combines public benchmarks with three internal benchmarks: MiMo Code Bench, MiMo Cyber Bench, and MiMo Visual Coding.
blocks.zh: 我们评价代理能力分为四个类别:代码代理、网络安全、一般代理和视觉代理。 我们的评价将公共基准与三个内部基准结合起来: 米莫代码座椅,米莫网络座椅,和米莫视觉编码.

blocks.en: We evaluate software-engineering capabilities using DeepSWE v1.1 ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , ProgramBench ( Yang et al., 2026a ) , and MiMo Code Bench. DeepSWE focuses on long-horizon development tasks. ProgramBench assesses end-to-end software construction: agents must reconstruct a program from its compiled binary and documentation, producing an implementation that reproduces the reference program’s behavior. MiMo Code Bench provides an additional in-house evaluation of coding agents across a diverse range of coding tasks.

CyberGym measures agents’ ability to reproduce vulnerabilities in real-world software, while SEC Bench Pro emphasizes reproducing complex vulnerabilities from bug reports. ExploitGym assesses exploit development beyond merely reproducing a crash, and ExploitBench evaluates progress through multiple exploitation stages and the resulting security impact. The performance changes are monitored during the process to validate the scaled RL compute.
As shown in Figure 9 , both Flash and Pro achieve overall improvements on DeepSWE v1.1, AutomationBench v1.0.6, and MiMo Visual Coding during RL training, despite fluctuations between checkpoints. These gains generally accompany increasing total token counts, showing that stronger task performance develops alongside greater token usage.
We further investigate the effect of multi-harness training,
with results demonstrated in Figure 10 . The dedicated training improves DeepSWE v1.1 performance across both the four training mini-harnesses and the three held-out harnesses: codex, claude code, and mini-swe-agent. Despite fluctuations between checkpoints, all three held-out harnesses improve over the course of training, with their mean Pass@1 increasing from approximately 50% to 66%. The gap between the mean performance on training and held-out harnesses also narrows, providing evidence that the learned coding capabilities transfer across harness implementations.
These results support our design of using lightweight, modular mini-harnesses to introduce controlled diversity during RL.

blocks.en: 5.4 Router Freezing for Stable RL

blocks.en: Figure 11 compares two MiMo-V2.6-Pro RL runs that differ only in whether the MoE router is frozen, tracking three expert-load statistics at decoder layer 9: the coefficient of variation (CV), the peak load factor (max/mean), and the fraction of cold experts below 0.1 × 0.1\times the mean (loads normalized per step). We observe a severe load-collapse problem when the router is trainable: all three metrics rise monotonically over the first 20 steps, with CV increasing from 0.78 0.78 to 2.0 2.0 , peak load from 6 × 6\times to 16 × 16\times , and the cold-expert fraction from 0.5 % 0.5\% to 22 % 22\% . To diagnose the cause, we restore the router parameters of the step-20 checkpoint to their initial pre-RL values while keeping all other parameters unchanged: load balance recovers to near-initial levels while benchmark performance remains unchanged, indicating that the collapse is driven by router drift rather than by degradation of the expert weights. We therefore freeze the router for RL training; the frozen-router run keeps all three statistics flat (CV ≈ 0.7 \approx 0.7 , peak load ≈ 5.5 × \approx 5.5\times , cold fraction near 1 % 1\% ) with benchmark performance growing normally.

blocks.en: Figure 12 summarizes interruptions in the MiMo-V2.6-Pro and MiMo-V2.6-Flash training runs. Infrastructure failures were primarily GPU-memory double-bit errors (DBEs). Flash was also restarted after a Kubernetes failure caused pods in the Cyber-task cluster to crash between steps 15 and 16. Pro was restarted after the grader became unreachable over the network after step 14. Rollout failures arose in the partial-rollout setting: shorter rollouts completed first after startup, biasing length estimates in Predictive Rollout Dispatch (§ 6.3 ) and exhausting both the GPU and pinned host-memory KV pools. Despite early refinements, one harness later produced rollouts less than half as long as those from other harnesses on the same code dataset, skewing estimates in the second and third steps after restart. Training failures were GPU out-of-memory (OOM) errors from MoE imbalance within a micro-batch: at one layer, an expert-parallel (EP) rank received over 30 × 30\times the mean token load despite a relatively balanced full batch. We adjusted parallelism to reduce activation memory and accommodate these peaks. Driver failures occurred during packing late in Flash as longer sequences increased per-node data volume beyond host-memory capacity. Although packing was distributed across nodes (§ 6.2 ), local memory demand still caused CPU OOM and interrupted the run.
blocks.zh: 图12总结了MiMo-V2.6-Pro和MiMo-V2.6-Flash培训的中断情况。 基础设施故障主要是GPU-memory双位错误(DBEs). 在一次Kubernetes故障导致Cyber任务集群的吊舱在步骤15和16之间崩溃后,闪电也被重新启动. Pro在14步后在网络上无法接触分级器后重启. 推出失败出现在部分推出的设定中:启动后先完成较短的推出,预测推出调度(第6.3节)中的长度估计偏差,并耗尽了GPU和被绑住的主机-memory KV集合. 尽管早期进行了改进,但一种接合装置后来的推出时间不及其他接合装置在同一编码数据集上推出时间的一半,在重新启动后的第二和第三步中扭曲了估计。 培训失败是GPU在微观批量中因教育部失衡而出现出错:一个层次上,一个专家-平行(EP)的分级,尽管批量相对均衡,却得到30×30\次的平均符号负载。 我们调整了平行性 以减少激活记忆 并适应这些峰值 在Flash的后期包装过程中发生了驱动故障,因为较长的序列使每个节点的数据量超过主机-记忆容量。 虽然包装在节点之间分布(§ 6.2),但本地内存需求仍然导致CPU OOM并中断了运行.

blocks.en: 6 RL and OPD Infrastructure
blocks.zh: 6 RL和OPD基础设施

blocks.en:
The MiMo-V2.6 series scales RL and OPD training to large mixed-task batches of agentic rollouts.
To support flexible agentic rollout scenarios, we define the execution model and trajectory data structure, and refine the learning signal with a Penalty Module (§ 6.1 ).
At large batch sizes, we implement the Harness Pool to host multiple harnesses and sustain high rollout concurrency, and the Payload Porter to buffer tens of thousands of trajectories heavy with routing and multimodal data (§ 6.2 ).
We implement a Sample Mixer that works with the dynamic sampler and partial rollout to stably deliver training batches matching a specified training distribution (§ 6.3 ).
Towards stable and efficient RL training, we align MoE routing and top- p sampling candidate sets between the training and inference engines, while optimizing both engines for RL workloads (§ 6.4 ).
blocks.zh:
MiMo-V2.6系列将RL和OPD培训规模扩大到大型混合任务分批的代理推出.
为了支持灵活的代理推出方案,我们界定了执行模式和轨迹数据结构,并用惩罚模块完善了学习信号(第6.1节)。
在大批量规模上,我们实施Harness Pool,以托管多条吊带并维持高推出率的通币,而活命波特则以路线和多模式数据来缓冲数以万计的轨迹(第6.2节)。
我们实施一个样本混合器,与动态取样器合作,并部分推出,以稳定地提供与特定培训分布相匹配的培训批次(第6.3节)。
为实现稳定和高效的RL培训,我们将教育部的路由和顶级抽样候选机组统一在培训和推论引擎之间,同时优化两个引擎的RL工作量(第6.4节)。

blocks.en: 6.1 Agentic RL with Fine-grained Learning Signals
blocks.zh: 6.1 有精致学习信号的干剂RL

blocks.en:
Agentic rollouts span multiple turns and dialogue contexts, while outcome rewards provide only coarse supervision.
We therefore adopt an agent-centric execution model and organize trajectory data as a hierarchy.
Within this hierarchy, a configurable Penalty Module applies loss masking and advantage shaping.
It targets local model errors and keeps infrastructure failures out of the training signal.
blocks.zh:
代理推出跨越多个回合和对话背景,而结果奖励只提供粗糙的监督。
因此,我们采用以代理人为中心的执行模式,并组织轨迹数据作为等级。
在这一等级体系中,可配置的惩罚单元适用损失遮盖和优势塑造。
它针对当地模式出错,使基础设施故障远离培训信号.

blocks.en:
We shift rollout from an inference-centric design to an agent-centric one: each sequence runs as an Agent Loop that owns the environment lifecycle, manages the dialogues it produces, and calls the inference engine on demand.
The lifecycle covers setup, interaction, reward evaluation (e.g., running test cases), and cleanup.
During interaction the loop exposes a request endpoint, and the external agent drives the rollout by calling it.
Each dialogue is kept both as a string prefix and as a token sequence.
Prefix matching locates the dialogue that an incoming request extends, and only the new suffix is tokenized and passed to the inference engine, keeping its interface purely token-in, token-out.
blocks.zh:
我们从一个以推论为中心的设计转向一个以推论为中心的设计:每个序列都作为拥有环境生命周期的Agent Loop运行,管理它产生的对话框,并按要求调用推论引擎.
生命周期包括设置,互动,奖励评价(如运行测试案例),以及清理.
在互动过程中,循环会暴露一个请求的终点,由外部代理通过调用来驱动推出.
每个对话框既作为字符串前缀保存,又作为符号序列保存.
前缀匹配会定位一个来件请求所延伸的对话框,只有新的后缀被标记并传递到推想引擎,使其界面保持纯正的指向,指向出.

blocks.en:
Subagents, context compaction, and multiple agent roles produce concurrent dialogue branches within one rollout.
We organize the trajectory data into a four-level hierarchy: Sample → \rightarrow Sequence → \rightarrow Context → \rightarrow Segment .
A Sample is a prompt dispatched by the Sample Mixer (§ 6.3 ).
In group-wise algorithms such as GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , the Sample spawns a group of Sequences , and the group is accepted or rejected as a whole.
A Sequence is one Agent Loop execution and may contain several concurrent Contexts .
A Context is one dialogue branch holding a list of Segments ; it is the unit of prefix matching, KV-cache reuse, and training-data export.
A Segment is a single turn—a system or user message, a model generation, or a tool result—and only model-generated turns contribute to the loss.
blocks.zh:
子剂,上下文收缩,以及多个代理角色,在一次推出中产生并行的对话分支.
我们把轨迹数据组织成四个等级: 样本 \正弦序 \正弦上下文 \正弦分节 。
样本由样本混合器发出(第6.3节)。
在GRPO等分组算法(Shao等,2024年)中,"样本"产出一组序列,该组整体接受或拒绝.
序列是一个代理循环执行,可能包含多个并行上下文。
上下文是一个对话框分支, 包含部分列表; 它是前缀匹配、 KV 缓存再利用、 以及培训数据导出的单位 。
一个部分是一个单一的转弯——一个系统或用户消息,一个模型生成,或者一个工具结果——只有模型生成的转弯才造成损失.

blocks.en:
Group-wise algorithms spread the outcome reward evenly across all model-generated tokens of a sequence.
Within the hierarchy above, credit is rarely uniform: some turns are off-path or degenerate, and some failures are unrelated to the model.
To assign credit where it is due, we separate detection from its effect on training.
A Rule judges a segment, context, or sequence by handcrafted logic or a model-based judge.
For example, rules can catch infrastructure failures not attributable to the model, garbled token patterns, calls to unavailable tools, and repetition.
A Strategy binds an action to a level of the hierarchy: mask excludes the hit content from the loss, advantage shaping sets, scales, or subtracts the advantages on hit tokens, and monitor records metrics alone.
The composite early stop strategy halts the rollout as soon as its rule fires, zeroes the outcome reward, applies separate actions to the triggering turn and earlier turns, and masks sibling contexts.
Penalties escalate along the hierarchy: a context with no surviving model turns is dropped, a sequence with no surviving context receives zero advantage, and a sample with no surviving sequence is rejected.
The specific penalties applied in training are described in § 4.3.3 .
blocks.zh:
分组算法将结果的奖励均匀地分布在一个序列的所有模型生成的符号上.
在以上等级体系中,信用很少统一:有些转折偏差或退化,有些失败与模型无关.
为了在适当时给予奖励,我们把检测与检测对培训的影响分开。
A级 规则通过手动逻辑或以模型为基础的法官来判断某一段、上下文或序列。
例如,规则可以抓住并非由模型造成的基础设施故障、被绑住的象征图案、对无法使用的工具的呼吁以及重复。
A级 策略将一个动作绑定到一个等级级别:遮罩将被击中的内容从损失中排除出,优势塑造套件,尺度,或者去掉被击中的符号上的优势,并且只监视记录的度量.
综合早期停站策略一旦规则起火,即停止推出,对结果奖励进行零分,对触发转会和更早转会分别适用动作,并用口罩打出兄弟背景.
惩罚沿着等级升级:一个没有存活模型转折的上下文被放弃,一个没有存活上下文的序列获得零优势,一个没有存活序列的样本被拒绝.
培训中的具体处罚见第4.3.3节。
